cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.lightning.des: Calls the Zeus to summon the Lightning nearby because you two are buddies, of course.
Summons a single-use bed that doesn't change your respawn point.

Summons a single-use bed where you're looking. The bed doesn't change your respawn point. In dimensions where beds are usable, the bed disappears in the morning and can only be placed at night or during thunderstorms.

cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_boat: Summons a boat that has a spectral storage, shared with your Spectral Donkey!

cantrip.forgotten_cantrips.spectral_donk: Summons a donkey, whose inventory is shared with your Spectral Boat!
